description: This file defines the DefaultMongoDbConfig class, which implements the MongoDbConfig interface. It serves as a configuration holder and loader for MongoDB settings such as URI, query timeout, pool configurations, circuit breaker, and monitoring, typically used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class provides methods to create an instance from a Config object and to access individual configuration parameters.

classes.name: DefaultMongoDbConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MongoDbConfig interface to load and represent MongoDB configuration, including URI, query timeouts, connection pool, circuit breaker, and monitoring settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of DefaultMongoDbConfig from a Config object, applying fallback values and resolving the MongoDB URI.

methods.name: getMaxQueryTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum query duration allowed, as configured.

methods.name: getOptionsConfig
methods.description: Returns the options configuration object for MongoDB.

methods.name: getConnectionPoolConfig
methods.description: Returns the connection pool configuration for MongoDB.
